_comment: 1D slab, 3 groups with upscatter (group 2 into group 1, so groups 1-2 are the thermal block the outer iteration sweeps and group 0 is solved once), all faces reflective with absorption in every group: the exact discrete solution is the per-group constant of the 3x3 infinite-medium group system, checked by -check_inf_medium. Each thermal group scatters half of what it does not self-scatter into the other, which makes the infinite-medium sweep contract the error by 0.25 per sweep.
